what_went_wrong_in_r71_to_r74: the addresser used role + accessible NAME. MiniWob widgets very often have no accessible name: the label sits in a sibling StaticText node, which ax_nodes dropped as noise. The agent could not see words that were visibly on the screen.

the_measurement.sample: 16 tasks whose goal names a literal that is a screen target
the_measurement.names_only_at_t0: 6/28 shown at t0 (21%) -- measured by string match, no parser

the_two_surviving_misses.why: the goal says 'x'; the control is a button named 'Close'. No string match bridges an action label to a symbol. That is semantics and needs a model.
the_two_surviving_misses.importance: this is the first clean example of a task that is unreachable at any amount of structural cleverness

four_measurement_errors_on_the_way_here: v1 kept trailing punctuation in the literal ('lacus,') so true matches scored as misses
v1 counted values-to-be-typed ('Leonie') as screen targets -- 8 of 36 were values, not targets
v2 counted the goal sentence itself as a hit, because the instruction is rendered text on the page
v2 measured 'names after revealing' instead of 'names ever seen'. Tab switching REPLACES content, so 3 -> 3 looked like nothing happened, and I nearly concluded revealing does not work.

the_law_this_adds.the_addressable_set_of_a_screen_is_tempo: what a screen can offer is the union of everything it can show across a sequence of interactions, not the set of nodes present at one instant
the_law_this_adds.why_it_matters: r73 said the ceiling was never the page. r74 said ordering was the constraint. r75 says the ceiling was the page's TEXT ALL ALONG, and it was there at t0 in most cases -- found only after the reveal loop because the reveal loop also changed the DOM

what_this_does_not_prove: that the benchmark score improves -- not re-measured yet
that text addressing generalises beyond MiniWob
next: re-run all 130 with find_text available to the policy
predict before running: this should beat 15/130 because the majority of the 22 off-screen literals were findable at t0 once text was included
